screens.name: Global search bar + autocomplete dropdown
screens.purpose: Main way into the shopping loop, on every page. Per a 2026 report, nearly 60% of US searches start from an autocomplete pick [V: search snippet]. It has to feel instant.
screens.url_pattern: Submits to /s?k={query}&i={deptAlias?}&crid={id}&sprefix={prefix},{alias},{ms}&ref=nb_sb_ss_{strategy}_{pos}_{prefixLen} (suggestion click) or ref=nb_sb_noss (typed Enter). Suggestion API: GET completion.amazon.com/api/2017/suggestions?prefix=…&alias=aps&limit=11 [V]
screens.layout: Desktop header row, left to right: amazon logo | 'Deliver to {Name} / {City} {ZIP}' with pin icon | SEARCH (grows to fill): [department select 'All' ▾, gray, auto-width to the chosen label] [text input, placeholder 'Search Amazon'] [orange/yellow square button with magnifier icon, aria-label 'Go'] | 'EN' flag | 'Hello, sign in / Account & Lists ▾' | 'Returns & Orders' | cart icon with count. When focused, the whole search field gets a 2-3px orange ring. The dropdown is a white panel directly under the input, as wide as the input plus select, with a dim overlay over the page behind it. Mobile web: search is a full-width row under the logo row (rounded input, orange magnifier button, no department select), and a teal 'Deliver to …' strip sits below it.
elements: Department select 'All' with options: All Departments, Alexa Skills, Amazon Devices, Amazon Fresh, Appliances, Apps & Games, Arts, Crafts & Sewing, Audible Books & Originals, Automotive Parts & Accessories, Baby, Beauty & Personal Care, Books, CDs & Vinyl, Cell Phones & Accessories, Clothing, Shoes & Jewelry, Computers, Electronics, Garden & Outdoor, Grocery & Gourmet Food, Health, Household & Baby Care, Home & Kitchen, Industrial & Scientific, Kindle Store, Luggage & Travel Gear, Movies & TV, Musical Instruments, Office Products, Pet Supplies, Smart Home, Software, Sports & Outdoors, Tools & Home Improvement, Toys & Games, Video Games (from memory)
Text input: placeholder 'Search Amazon'. The last query stays filled in on the results page.
Submit button: magnifier icon on orange #febd69
Suggestion rows: up to 10 keyword completions [V: API returns 10]. Typed prefix in normal weight, the completed part in bold (memory).
Past searches (signed in or same session) listed first, in a different text color, each with a 'Remove' link on desktop (clock icon + X on the mobile app) (memory)

2025-26 additions: product thumbnails on some suggestions [V: snippet], Rufus question rows like 'What finishes are available for large metal wall art?' [V: ecomtent], and from May 2026 'Alexa for Shopping' answers questions typed into the bar while keyword queries still go to the normal results page [V: Retail Dive]
The API's 'predictiveText' field (e.g. 'wireless earbuds' for 'wireless ear') supports ghost-text completion [V]
states: Empty and focused: past searches if there are any, otherwise nothing opens
Typing: suggestions update on every keypress (event=onkeypress). The last result stays visible while the next one loads, with no spinner.
No suggestions: dropdown closes. Enter still searches.
API error: silently no dropdown; search still works
Department scoped (e.g. Books): suggestions come from that department's alias (alias=stripbooks gave 'harry potter books', 'harry potter illustrated' [V])
Department hints like 'in Electronics' under the first suggestion: an older pattern. Three live API calls in Sep 2026 returned no scope fields, so treat it as gone or rare [V: absence].
Empty submit with 'All' selected: nothing happens. Empty submit with a department selected: goes to that department's page (memory).
interactions: Up/Down arrows move the highlight and write the suggestion into the input; Esc restores the typed text and closes
Enter or clicking a suggestion runs the search right away
Mouse hover highlights a row in light gray
Clicking outside or tabbing away closes the dropdown
'Remove' on a past search deletes it on the spot without closing the dropdown
Changing the department select re-scopes suggestions and search. Picking from the select does not submit.

screens.name: Search results page (desktop)
screens.purpose: Scan, narrow down, compare and add to cart without opening each product. This is the core of the shopping loop.
screens.url_pattern: /s?k=wireless+earbuds [&i=electronics] [&rh=n:172282,p_123:{brandId},p_72:1248879011 (4 Stars & Up),p_36:2500-5000 (price in cents; p_36:-2500 = up to $25),p_85:2470955011 (Prime),p_90:8308920011 (Get It by Tomorrow),p_n_deal_type:23566064011 (Today's Deals, V: search result URL),p_n_condition-type:…] [&s=relevanceblender|price-asc-rank|price-desc-rank|review-rank|date-desc-rank|exact-aware-popularity-rank] [&page=2] &qid={ts}&ref=sr_pg_2. Browse without a query: /s?i=electronics&rh=n:12097478011
screens.layout: Desktop, top to bottom: (1) global header + sub-nav ('☰ All', 'Today's Deals', 'Registry', 'Customer Service', 'Gift Cards', 'Sell'). (2) Thin results bar with a bottom border: left '1-48 of over 10,000 results for "wireless earbuds"' (query in bold orange-brown #c45500); right a 'Sort by: Featured ▾' button-select. (3) Sometimes a Sponsored Brands banner (brand logo, headline, 3 products, 'Shop {Brand} ›'). (4) Two columns. Left sidebar about 240px, filter sections stacked with bold headings. Main column has an H2 'Results' with a small gray note 'Check each product page for other buying options. Price and other details may vary based on product size and color.', then the results. Layout depends on category: GRID of 4-5 columns (24-60 per page, often 48) for home, fashion, beauty and most goods; LIST of one row per item, image left about 220px and details right (16 per page), for books, laptops, TVs and many electronics. Carousels are mixed in between result rows: 'Highly rated', 'Top rated from our brands', 'Customers frequently viewed', 'Explore related searches', 'Brands related to your search' (Sponsored), sponsored video. A 'More results' heading follows those blocks. (5) Pagination bar, centered. (6) 'Need help?' block. (7) 'Related searches' as a grid of pill links with magnifier icons. (8) 'Your browsing history' / recently viewed strip. (9) 'Back to top' bar + footer.
elements: Count line format: '{start}-{end} of {N} results for "{q}"'. Exact N when small ('1-16 of 243 results'), otherwise rounded ('over 1,000', 'over 2,000', … 'over 10,000', 'over 50,000', 'over 100,000'). Without a query it names the category path: '1-24 of over 80,000 results for Electronics : Headphones, Earbuds & Accessories : Earbud & In-Ear Headphones'. Page 2 starts at '49-96 of …'.

Sort options, exact: 'Featured', 'Price: Low to High', 'Price: High to Low', 'Avg. Customer Review', 'Newest Arrivals', 'Best Sellers'. Books add 'Publication Date'. Picking one reloads at page 1. [V: Feedvisor lists Featured, Price Low to High, Price High to Low, Average Customer Review, Newest Arrivals]

SIDEBAR, typical order for an electronics query: 'Eligible for Free Shipping' [☐ Free Shipping by Amazon, with gray note 'Get FREE Shipping on eligible orders shipped by Amazon'] · 'Delivery Day' [☐ Get It Today / ☐ Get It by Tomorrow / ☐ Get It in 2 Days] [V: Feedvisor] · Prime [☐ ✓prime logo] · 'Department' tree ('‹ Any Department', parent 'Electronics', current child in bold, children indented, 'See all 12 Departments') · 'Customer Reviews' [★★★★☆ '& Up' row, aria text '4 Stars & Up'] · 'Brands' [☐ Top Brands, then ☐ Apple, ☐ Soundcore, ☐ JBL, ☐ Sony, ☐ Samsung, ☐ Bose, ☐ Beats, then '▾ See more' which expands inline and flips to 'See less'] · 'Price' [links: Up to $25 / $25 to $50 / $50 to $100 / $100 to $200 / $200 & above, then '$ Min' '$ Max' inputs + 'Go' button. Since about 2023 many queries show a two-handle slider '$18 – $300+' with a 'Go' button instead] · 'Deals & Discounts' [All Discounts / Today's Deals] [V: snippet] · category facets such as 'Headphone Features' (Active Noise Cancellation, Microphone Included, Water Resistant), 'Connectivity Technology', 'Headphones Form Factor' (In Ear, On Ear, Over Ear), 'Color' (grid of color squares), 'Compatible Devices' · 'Seller' [Amazon.com] · 'Condition' [New / Used / Renewed] [V: Feedvisor adds Collectible] · 'Availability' [☐ Include Out of Stock] · 'Climate Pledge Friendly' [V] · 'From Our Brands' · 'Subscribe & Save'

Applied filter: the option turns bold and its checkbox fills. A small 'Clear' link appears right under that section heading. Department uses '‹ Any Department' as its back-out. Desktop has no top chip row and no global 'Clear all' (memory).

RESULT CARD (grid), top to bottom: optional badge in the top-left corner of the image area ('Best Seller' orange #e47911 tag; 'Amazon's Choice' navy #232f3e tag with 'Choice' in orange; 'Overall Pick' navy tag; 'Limited time deal' red #cc0c39 tag) · square image on light gray #f7f7f7 (product image blended onto the gray) · color swatch dots under the image with '+5' overflow (fashion/home) · 'Sponsored' in small gray text with an ⓘ icon · brand name in bold (fashion) · title link, #0f1111, 2-4 lines clamped, turns #c7511f and underlined on hover · rating row: '4.4' + stars + '▾' + '(58.3K)' abbreviated count (aria: '4.4 out of 5 stars') · '10K+ bought in past month' in small gray text right under the rating [V: Intentwise, 'just below the star rating'; buckets like 50+/100+/800+/1K+/10K+/100K+] · price: superscript '$', large dollars, superscript cents ('$29⁹⁹'), optional unit price '($0.50/Count)' · reference price: gray 'List: ~~$49.99~~' or 'Typical: ~~$39.99~~' (the label is not struck through) [V: help and seller docs; Typical = 90-day median price paid, excluding limited-time deals; since Apr-May 2026 only shown when validated] · coupon: green tag 'Save 15%' + 'with coupon', or 'Save $5.00 with coupon' · promos: 'Lowest price in 30 days', 'Save 10% on 2 select item(s)' · delivery: ✓prime logo, 'FREE delivery **Tue, Sep 16**', 'Or fastest delivery **Tomorrow, Sep 15**'. Signed out or non-Prime: 'FREE delivery Tue, Sep 16 on $35 of items shipped by Amazon' · stock: 'Only 3 left in stock - order soon.' in red #b12704 · 'Options: 3 sizes, 8 colors' link · 'Climate Pledge Friendly' leaf + '1 sustainability feature' · yellow pill button 'Add to cart' (#ffd814), or white outlined 'See options' for products with variations

LIST card extras: badge row 'Best Seller' + 'in Earbud & In-Ear Headphones'. Books show format rows ('Paperback', 'Kindle', 'Hardcover', 'Audible Audiobook'), each with its own price and delivery line, plus 'Other formats:'. Also 'More Buying Choices $19.99 (12 used & new offers)'.
Rating popover on hover over stars/▾: '4.4 out of 5', '58,312 global ratings', 5 bars '5 star 68%', '4 star 17%'…, 'See customer reviews ›'
Sponsored ⓘ popover: 'You're seeing this ad based on the product's relevance to your search query.' + 'Leave ad feedback' (memory)

Pagination: '‹ Previous' (grayed out on page 1) · '1' (current, boxed and bold) · '2' · '3' · '…' · '20' · 'Next ›'. Only about 20 pages of 16 or about 7 pages of 48 can be reached, even when the count says 'over 10,000'.
'Need help?' heading + 'Visit the help section or contact us' (both links)
'Related searches': about 8-16 pill links (e.g. 'wireless earbuds bluetooth', 'wireless earbuds noise cancelling', 'wireless earphones')
states: Loading: server-rendered. A filter, sort or page change is a full navigation, and on slow networks the old results stay dimmed until the new page paints. No skeletons on desktop.

Spelling corrected: above the results, 'Showing results for **wireless earbuds**' and on the next line 'Search instead for wirless earbuds' (link) [V: seller forum quote 'Showing results for [other brand]. Search instead for [our brand].']

Zero results: large '**No results for** asdfqwer.' then 'Try checking your spelling or use more general terms', then the 'Need help?' block and sometimes sponsored or recommended carousels. With a department: 'No results for B00BIHRYTY in Books.' [V: Goodreads quote]
Some words dropped: 'No results for "a b c".' followed by 'Results for "a b"' (memory)
Filters leave few or zero results: Amazon hides options with zero results rather than showing counts, so an empty filtered page is rare

Signed out vs signed in: signed out shows 'FREE delivery … on $35 of items shipped by Amazon'. Prime members see 'FREE delivery Tomorrow'. Delivery dates depend on the 'Deliver to' ZIP. Past searches only appear when signed in or within the session.
Out of stock: hidden by default ('Include Out of Stock' filter). When shown: no price, 'Currently unavailable.' or 'No featured offers available' + '$24.95 (5 used & new offers)', and no Add to cart
Add to cart pending/success: the button turns into a stepper [🗑 1 +] (trash icon at qty 1, − above 1), the header cart count goes up, and sometimes a short green 'Added' note (memory)
Deal item: 'Limited time deal' badge. Some variants show a red '-25%' before the price.
Variation product: price range '$19.99 - $34.99' and 'See options' instead of Add to cart
interactions: Clicking a filter link or checkbox navigates right away (one click, one reload). No apply button except 'Go' for custom price.
Brands and facet checkboxes: OR within one section, AND across sections. Customer Reviews and Price range are single choice.
'See more' / 'See less' expand and collapse long lists in place
Custom price: Min/Max are numbers only. Pressing Go with both empty does nothing. With only Min it filters '$50 & above'. If Min > Max Amazon swaps or ignores them (memory).
Sort: native-style select. Changing it submits and resets page=1 but keeps filters.
Card: image and title go to /dp/{ASIN}; the rating count goes to /dp/{ASIN}#customerReviews; hovering a swatch changes the card image
Pagination and filters keep k, i and rh in the URL, so pages are shareable and Back works
Hovering the rating stars opens the histogram popover after a short delay
microcopy: Check each product page for other buying options. Price and other details may vary based on product size and color.
You're seeing this ad based on the product's relevance to your search query.
FREE delivery Tue, Sep 16 on $35 of items shipped by Amazon
Only 3 left in stock - order soon.
Try checking your spelling or use more general terms
Visit the help section or contact us

screens.name: Search results page (mobile web) + filter sheet
screens.purpose: The same narrowing on a phone. The sidebar moves into a full-screen sheet and quick chips sit up top.
screens.layout: Sticky: search bar row, then a 'Deliver to …' strip. Next, a horizontally scrolling chip row: 'Filters' with a sliders icon (becomes 'Filters (2)' when filters are on), then shortcuts like '✓prime', 'Get It by Tomorrow', '4 Stars & Up', brand names, 'Under $25' [V: Feedvisor/snippet: Prime, Today, 4 Stars & Up, brands as chips]. Then 'RESULTS' label + count. Cards are one column (image about 40% on the left, text on the right) for most categories, two columns for fashion. Card contents match desktop; the 'Add to cart' button sits in the right column. Pagination at the bottom.
elements: Filters sheet (full screen, slides up): header 'Filters' + close X. Sections: 'Sort by' (Featured, Price: Low to High, Price: High to Low, Avg. Customer Review, Newest Arrivals, Best Sellers as pills), 'Prime & Delivery', 'Customer Reviews', 'Brands' (top chips + 'See all'), 'Price & Deals' (slider + range pills + Today's Deals), 'Department', category facets, 'Condition'
Sticky footer in the sheet: 'Clear Filters' (text) and a primary 'Show 1,000+ results' button [V: aboutamazon 'Filters' → 'Browse by' → 'Show Results']
Active chips stay highlighted (dark outline / filled) in the chip row
states: No filters: 'Filters' chip with no count
Filters on: 'Filters (n)' and highlighted chips; tapping a highlighted chip turns it off
Sheet counting results: the button label updates to the new count after each tap
Zero results: same 'No results for' copy as desktop
interactions: Tapping a quick chip applies it immediately and reloads the results
Inside the sheet, taps are collected; 'Show … results' applies them all, and closing the sheet with X throws them away
Scroll position of the chip row is kept

screens.name: Category browse: All menu + department landing
screens.purpose: Browsing without a query: department → subcategory → narrowed results page.
screens.url_pattern: Store-style landing: /b?node=172282 (Electronics) or /b/?node=…. Leaf categories open results pages: /s?i=electronics&rh=n:12097478011&ref=… . The 'All' menu uses in-page JS.
screens.layout: HAMBURGER '☰ All' opens a left side sheet about 365px wide over a dark overlay, with X to close. Header bar 'Hello, sign in' / 'Hello, {Name}' with a user icon. Sections split by rules: 'Digital Content & Devices' (Prime Video, Amazon Music, Kindle E-readers & Books, Amazon Appstore) · 'Shop by Department' (Electronics, Computers, Smart Home, Arts & Crafts, then 'See all ▾' expanding in place) · 'Programs & Features' · 'Help & Settings' (Your Account, English, United States, Customer Service, Sign in). Clicking a department slides in a sub-panel: '‹ MAIN MENU' at the top, a bold department title, then subcategories. Some menu versions also have a 'Trending' section (Best Sellers, New Releases, Movers & Shakers). DEPARTMENT LANDING (/b?node): department sub-nav bar under the header (e.g. 'Electronics | TV & Video | Audio & Home Theater | Computers | Camera & Photo | Wearable Technology | Car Electronics & GPS | Portable Audio | Cell Phones | Office Electronics | Musical Instruments | Deals'). Hero banner. 'Shop by category' grid of image tiles with labels. Carousels such as 'Best Sellers in Electronics', 'Top deals', 'New releases', 'Featured brands'. A left sidebar with the department tree on many nodes. Mid- and leaf-level nodes skip the landing page and render the results page with the tree pre-selected. Mobile: menu is full screen; landing pages stack tiles in 2 or 3 columns.
elements: Side sheet with headings, rows with a '›' chevron, 'See all' / 'See less' expander, '‹ MAIN MENU' back link
Department sub-nav links
Category tiles (square image + label)
Horizontal product carousels with prev/next arrows and 'See more'
Department tree in the results sidebar: '‹ Any Department' › parent › current (bold) › children
states: Signed out: menu header 'Hello, sign in'
Carousel lazy-loads as it scrolls into view
Node with no products: results-page zero state
interactions: Clicking a department row slides the panel left (about 200ms); '‹ MAIN MENU' slides back
Esc, X or the overlay closes the sheet; focus returns to the ☰ button
Tile click → results page scoped to that node

screens.name: Best Sellers
screens.purpose: Ranked top-100 lists by sales for each category. A high-trust shortcut when you don't know what to search for.
screens.layout: Tab strip at the top: 'Best Sellers' | 'New Releases' | 'Movers & Shakers' | 'Most Wished For' | 'Gift Ideas' (current tab underlined/bold). H1 'Amazon Best Sellers' with the subline 'Our most popular products based on sales. Updated frequently.' [V: search snippet]. Two columns. LEFT sidebar: 'Any Department' then an alphabetical department list (Amazon Devices & Accessories, Amazon Renewed, Appliances, Apps & Games, Arts, Crafts & Sewing, Audible Books & Originals, Automotive, Baby, Beauty & Personal Care, Books, Camera & Photo Products, CDs & Vinyl, Cell Phones & Accessories, Clothing, Shoes & Jewelry, Computers & Accessories, Digital Music, Electronics, Gift Cards, Grocery & Gourmet Food, Handmade Products, Health & Household, Home & Kitchen, Industrial & Scientific, Kindle Store, Kitchen & Dining, Movies & TV, Musical Instruments, Office Products, Patio, Lawn & Garden, Pet Supplies, Software, Sports & Outdoors, Tools & Home Improvement, Toys & Games, Video Games). When drilled in: '‹ Any Department' › '‹ Electronics' › bold current › indented children [V: JumpFly 'category breaks down on the left side']. MAIN on the overview: stacked sections 'Best Sellers in {Category}', each with a 'See More' link on the right and a horizontal carousel with ‹ › arrows and 'Page 1 of 10'. MAIN on a category: H1 'Best Sellers in Electronics', then a grid of 50 cards (4-5 per row), with rows below the first batch lazy-loading on scroll, then a pager 'Previous page' / 'Next page' covering 2 pages = 100 items [V: Apify listing '100 products per chart, split across two pages of 50']. Mobile: the department list becomes a dropdown/accordion at the top; cards go to 2 columns or a list.
elements: Rank badge: '#1' in an orange-brown tag at the card's top-left corner
Card: square image, title link (clamped to about 3 lines), stars + count '(12,345)', price '$24.99', or '2 offers from $19.99' when there is no featured offer
No filters, no sort, no Add to cart on list cards (memory)
Movers & Shakers card extras: green ▲ / red ▼ '345%' plus 'Sales rank: 32 (previously 142)'

Tab sublines (memory): New Releases 'Our best-selling new and future releases. Updated frequently.'; Movers & Shakers 'Our biggest gainers in sales rank over the past 24 hours. Updated frequently.'; Most Wished For 'Our products most often added to Wishlists and Registries. Updated daily.'; Gift Ideas 'Our most popular products most often purchased as gifts. Updated daily.'
states: Loading: first 30 cards server-rendered, rest lazy-loaded with gray placeholders
Category with fewer than 100 ranked items: shorter grid, no page 2
Item out of stock: still ranked; price replaced by offers text or left empty
Signed in and out look the same
interactions: Clicking a sidebar category reloads with that category's top 100
Carousel arrows page by about 6 cards and update 'Page n of 10'
'See More' → full category list
Card → /dp/{ASIN}

screens.name: Today's Deals
screens.purpose: Browse time-limited discounts: see % off, urgency and value at a glance.
screens.url_pattern: /deals (current; /gp/goldbox redirects here). Filtered deal results: /s?rh=n:2235625011,p_n_deal_type:23566064011 [V: this URL appears titled 'Amazon.com: Today's Deals']. Deal groups: /deal/{dealId}
screens.layout: Desktop: H1 'Today's Deals'. Below it, a horizontal row of category pills that can scroll: 'All' (selected, dark fill), 'Amazon Devices', 'Beauty', 'Computers', 'Electronics', 'Fashion', 'Home', 'Kitchen', 'Toys & Games', 'Video Games'… During events a banner shows (e.g. 'Prime Big Deal Days', 'Today's Big Deals' daily themed drops at midnight PDT [V: TechRadar]). Two columns. LEFT filters: 'Department' (single choice, 'See more'), 'Customer Reviews' ('4 Stars & Up') [V], 'Brands' (checkboxes), 'Price' ('Up to $25', '$25 to $50', '$50 to $100', '$100 to $200', '$200 & Above'), 'Discount' ('10% off or more', '25% off or more', '50% off or more', '70% off or more'), 'Prime Programs' / deal type ('Lightning deals', 'Prime Exclusive Deals') [V: aboutamazon 'Browse by' → 'Lightning Deals']. MAIN: deal grid of 4-6 columns that keeps loading as you scroll, sometimes interleaved with carousels ('Top deals for you', 'Deals under $25'). Mobile: chip row + 'Filters' sheet ('Browse by', 'Show Results' [V]), 2-column grid.
elements: Deal card: square image on #f7f7f7 · red rounded tag '25% off' (white text on #cc0c39), with red text beside it 'Limited time deal' (or 'Lightning Deal', 'Prime Big Deal', 'Deal') · price '$29.99' with superscript cents · 'List: $39.99' or 'Typical: $39.99' struck through in gray · title clamped to 2 lines · for deals across several products: 'Up to 35% off' + 'Deals from $12.99' + 'See all deals'
Lightning deal extras: 'fuel gauge' progress bar with '45% claimed' and a countdown 'Ends in 03:12:44' [V: aboutamazon/reolink: discount banner, countdown, % claimed status bar]

Sold out or fully held in carts: '100% claimed' + 'Join waitlist' button; status text '100% of the promotional discounts are held in other customer carts or have been used' [V: aboutamazon]. Carts that don't check out within 15 minutes release the item to the next person on the waitlist [V].
Prime-exclusive: 'Prime exclusive deal' / 'With Prime' label. Signed out or non-Prime sees 'Join Prime to get this deal' (memory)
Upcoming (event days): 'Starts in 1h 23m'
states: Loading: gray card placeholders while the next batch arrives
No deals match the filters: 'No deals found' style empty grid, with a prompt to clear filters (memory, low confidence on exact copy)
Deal expired mid-view: card drops off on refresh; at checkout the price reverts to normal
Countdown under 1h ticks in seconds, otherwise 'Ends in 6h 23m'
Signed out: all deals visible; Prime-exclusive prices shown but blocked behind Prime
interactions: Category pill: single choice, refilters the grid without leaving the page
Sidebar filters: Department and Discount single choice, Brands multi-select; each click refilters
Card click → product page with the deal price and 'Limited time deal' badge, or /deal/{id} for groups
'Join waitlist' → toggles to 'On waitlist' (memory)
microcopy: Join Prime to get this deal

flows.name: Autocomplete to results
steps: Focus the header search (click, Tab, or '/' in the rebuild); past searches appear if there are any
Type 'wireless ear'. After a ~100ms debounce, GET /api/suggest?q=wireless%20ear&dept=all returns up to 10 terms with the typed part normal and the completion bold
Down arrow twice highlights 'wireless earbuds noise cancelling' and writes it into the input
Enter → /s?k=wireless+earbuds+noise+cancelling; the query is saved to recent searches
Results page renders: count line, Sort by: Featured, sidebar, cards

flows.name: Narrow and sort on the results page
steps: On /s?k=wireless+earbuds, tick Brands › 'Sony' → URL gets brand=Sony, page resets to 1, count line updates, a 'Clear' link appears under Brands
Tick 'JBL' → OR within Brands (Sony or JBL)
Click Customer Reviews '4 Stars & Up' → AND with brands
Type $ Min 25, $ Max 100, press Go (or Enter) → price filter on; the preset ranges show none selected
Change Sort by to 'Price: Low to High' → reorders, keeps filters, page 1
Click 'Next ›' → page=2, count line reads '49-96 of …'; Back returns to page 1 with the same filters
Click 'Clear' under Brands → brand filter removed, other filters kept

flows.name: Add to cart straight from results
steps: Result card shows yellow 'Add to cart' (simple product, in stock)
Click → button shows a busy state; POST /api/cart {productId, qty:1}
Success → button becomes stepper [🗑 1 +], header cart count +1, polite live-region message 'Added to cart'
Click + → qty 2 (trash icon becomes −); 🗑 at qty 1 removes it and brings back 'Add to cart'
Product with variations shows 'See options' → goes to the product page with the variant picker
Error (out of stock since the page loaded) → button reverts, inline red text 'This item is no longer available' (rebuild copy)

flows.name: Misspelling and zero results
steps: Search 'wirless earbuds' → zero exact matches; fuzzy match finds 'wireless earbuds'
Page shows 'Showing results for wireless earbuds' and 'Search instead for wirless earbuds' with results for the corrected query
Clicking 'Search instead for' → /s?k=wirless+earbuds&nfpr=1 (no correction) → zero results state

Zero results: 'No results for wirless earbuds.' + 'Try checking your spelling or use more general terms' + 'Need help?' block; rebuild adds popular searches and 'Search all departments' when a department was selected

flows.name: Browse by category
steps: Click '☰ All' → side sheet slides in from the left
Shop by Department › 'Electronics' › sub-panel slides in › 'Headphones'
Lands on /s?i=electronics&rh=n:{node}; count line names the category path; sidebar tree has 'Headphones' in bold with children
Click child 'Earbud & In-Ear Headphones' → narrower results; '‹ Electronics' / '‹ Any Department' move back up
Apply filters and sort exactly as in the query flow

flows.name: Best Sellers
steps: Click 'Best Sellers' in the sub-nav (or menu Trending) → /gp/bestsellers overview with 'Best Sellers in {Category}' carousels
Click 'Electronics' in the left list → 'Best Sellers in Electronics' grid of #1-#50
Drill into 'Headphones' → subcategory top 50
'Next page' → #51-#100
Click #3 card → product page

flows.name: Today's Deals
steps: Click 'Today's Deals' in the sub-nav → /deals grid, 'All' pill selected
Click 'Electronics' pill → grid refilters
Sidebar Discount '25% off or more' → only deals ≥25% off
Lightning deal card shows '62% claimed' and 'Ends in 02:14:09'

flows.name: Mobile filtering
steps: On a phone, results show a chip row: 'Filters', '✓prime', '4 Stars & Up', brand chips
Tap '✓prime' chip → applied at once, chip highlighted, 'Filters (1)'
Tap 'Filters' → full-screen sheet; pick Sort 'Price: Low to High', Brands 'Sony'; button label updates to 'Show 42 results'
Tap 'Show 42 results' → sheet closes, results update; X instead would have thrown away the pending picks
'Clear Filters' in the sheet resets everything except the query

priorities.feature: Autocomplete: up to 10 prefix suggestions, bold completion, arrow/Enter/Esc keyboard nav, ARIA combobox

priorities.feature: Results page: count line, results grid, pagination, URL-driven state (k, dept, brand[], rating, price_min/max, prime, sort, page)

priorities.feature: Result card: image, title, stars + count, price with superscript cents, strike 'List:' price, Prime badge + 'FREE delivery {date}', stock line

better_than_original: Show applied filters as removable chips above the results with 'Clear all' (Amazon desktop hides them as bold links plus per-section 'Clear' in the sidebar; Baymard finds 42% of sites fail to surface applied filters at the top)
Update filters without a full reload (fetch + history.pushState, keep scroll, dim results with skeletons) while URLs stay shareable and Back still works

Honest counts: exact 'N results' and a count next to each filter option ('Sony (12)'); options that would give zero are disabled with a reason. Never say 'over 10,000' when only about 336 can be reached.
Organic results only, no Sponsored rows or mid-list carousels, so every card is a real match and pages scan faster
One badge max per card, each with a tooltip saying why ('Best Seller: #1 by sales in Earbuds, updated hourly'). Amazon stacks up to 4 unexplained tags.
Price clarity: show '% saved' next to the strike price, define 'Typical price' inline (90-day median price paid), and always show unit price where it matters
One consistent delivery line ('FREE delivery Tue, Sep 16') instead of 2-3 variants with small-print conditions; dates set by the Deliver-to ZIP

Real form controls: filters as <fieldset> checkboxes/radios, not styled links; autocomplete as an ARIA combobox with aria-activedescendant; stars carry text '4.4 out of 5 stars, 58,312 ratings'; visible focus rings; '/' shortcut to focus search
Price Min/Max accepts Enter, swaps min > max automatically, and shows inline validation ('Enter a number') instead of silently ignoring input
Smarter zero results: offer 'Remove last filter', 'Search all departments', spelling fix, and popular searches instead of just 'Try checking your spelling'
Countdowns that respect users: coarse 'Ends in 3h 12m' until the last hour, no ticking announced to screen readers, reduced-motion friendly
Best Sellers with a real 'Updated 2 hours ago' timestamp and optional Prime/price filters, instead of the vague 'Updated frequently' and no filters
Grid rows line up: fixed-ratio image boxes (no layout shift), titles clamped to the same line count with the full title on hover
Add to cart confirms in place (stepper + toast with an Undo link) and never leaves the results page
Mobile filter sheet shows the live count ('Show 42 results') and keeps sort in the same sheet; a sticky compact sort/filter bar on scroll
Speed: first results page server-rendered, next page prefetched, product pages prefetched on hover/touchstart, responsive images with width hints

fields: ships_in_days (int, for delivery date + Get It by Tomorrow filter)
is_prime_member (for the FREE delivery line wording)
